s.en: Power off, reboot, or halt the machine

o.en: Print a short help text and exit. Added in version 253.
Halt the machine, regardless of which one of the three commands is invoked. Added in version 253.
Power off the machine, when either halt or poweroff is invoked. This option is ignored when reboot is invoked. Added in version 253.
Reboot the machine, regardless of which one of the three commands is invoked. Added in version 253.

Force immediate power-off, halt, or reboot. If specified, the command does not contact the init system. In most cases, filesystems are not properly unmounted before shutdown. For example, the command reboot -f is mostly equivalent to systemctl reboot -ff, instead of systemctl reboot -f. Added in version 253.
Only write wtmp shutdown entry, do not actually power off, reboot, or halt. Added in version 253.
Do not write wtmp shutdown entry. Added in version 253.
Do not sync hard disks/storage media before power-off, reboot, or halt. Added in version 253.
Do not send wall message before power-off, reboot, or halt. Added in version 253.
